TechnologyStack.Runtime: None required for repository readers or Markdown-only task authoring
TechnologyStack.Language: GitHub Flavored Markdown; embedded JavaScript, TypeScript, JSX, and TSX use task-specific versions
TechnologyStack.Framework: GitHub repository rendering; React examples use task-specific versions

dep.name: github-markdown-renderer
dep.purpose: Render README files, relative links, code fences, tables, and collapsed details sections

constraint.reason: Each task must state any language, React, or browser API version assumptions that affect its solution
Migrated pure TypeScript cards preserve the approved TypeScript 5.9 behavior
Migrated React cards preserve the approved React 19.2 behavior

tool.name: temporary-validation
tool.value: task-appropriate JavaScript, TypeScript, React, DOM, or browser harness

ContentVocabulary.language-policy: Russian task prose and stable section labels by default; task-specific exceptions require mentor direction.
ContentVocabulary.metadata-labels: Технология; Подборка; Формат; Сложность; Примерное время
ContentVocabulary.technology-policy: Use exactly JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML/CSS, HTML/JavaScript, HTML/CSS/JavaScript, or React/TypeScript.
ContentVocabulary.collection-policy: Use the one approved thematic collection that owns the card; introducing a collection requires mentor approval.
ContentVocabulary.format-policy: Use exactly Написать код, Исправить код, Разобрать код, or Предсказать результат.
ContentVocabulary.difficulty-policy: Use Базовая for one direct concept, Средняя for combined concepts or meaningful approach choice, and Продвинутая for nontrivial execution models, architecture, state, asynchrony, or competing-solution tradeoffs.
ContentVocabulary.duration-policy: Use an integer number of minutes and synchronize it with the thematic and optional interview collection entries.
ContentVocabulary.preservation-policy: Move every source learning goal, prerequisite, and runtime assumption to a visible destination or record a concrete not-applicable reason in CardMigrationEvidence.
ContentVocabulary.environment-policy: Choose one fixed editor profile and declare browser, classic or ESM mode, language, framework, or browser-version assumptions next to the copy/run instruction when they affect behavior.

profile-Programiz.scope: Console JavaScript without browser API, DOM, or Node-specific semantics
profile-Programiz.copy-run-contract: One complete JavaScript block for main.js.

profile-CodePen.scope: Browser JavaScript, DOM, HTML/CSS, classic script, or ESM
profile-CodePen.copy-run-contract: Prefer one complete HTML block with embedded style and script; state classic script or type=module explicitly.

profile-TypeScriptPlayground.copy-run-contract: One complete TypeScript block unless several files are essential to the learning goal.

profile-ReactTypeScript.scope: React and TypeScript with React 19.2 behavior
profile-ReactTypeScript.copy-run-contract: Replace src/App.tsx completely; add files only when the task genuinely needs them.

TaskEditorProfileMap.mapping-state: Phase 8 fixes the profile assignment; target-editor evidence for each card remains pending in its owning migration phase.

profile-assignment-CodePenBrowserESM.task-slugs: this-callback-binding, stale-search-response, delegated-dynamic-list, idempotent-event-listeners, accessible-keyboard-tabs, modal-focus-lifecycle

PreferredAgentStack.preferred-content-format: GitHub Flavored Markdown with relative repository links
PreferredAgentStack.preferred-progressive-disclosure: Exactly three independent hint details blocks, then closed solution, self-check, optional reading, and five-field metadata
PreferredAgentStack.preferred-verification: Strict structural, preservation, content, synchronization, target-editor, browser, link, XML, and GitHub rendered-view evidence; temporary harnesses are diagnostic only
PreferredAgentStack.preferred-grace-resolution: Resolve grace from PATH, then fall back to $HOME/.bun/bin/grace before treating the CLI as unavailable.

discouraged-surface.reason: The initial project intentionally has no repository runtime.

PreferredAgentStack.discouraged-surface: catalog generators, site frameworks, and package-manager-based Markdown pipelines

module-level.command: Verify the selected StudentTaskCard mode, preservation ledger, copy-ready code, FILE parity, three exact hints, five metadata fields, collection membership, and final target-editor expected, actual, and verdict.
module-level.focus: Prove document structure, source-contract preservation, and solution behavior in the named online editor without adding a permanent repository runtime.

wave-level.command: Validate the serialized redesign unit; compare each changed card with exactly one thematic and zero or one interview entry, graph and verification facts, resolve links, record CardMigrationEvidence, push the focused commit, and capture required rendered evidence.
wave-level.focus: Prove migration quality and atomic synchronization across card, collections, knowledge graph, verification plan, and Beads evidence.

phase-level.command: Run xmllint on docs/*.xml, scan changed files for whitespace and placeholder defects, review the full catalog projection, and inspect GitHub rendering when template or HTML markup changes.
phase-level.focus: Repository-wide structural integrity and student-visible GitHub behavior.

Testing.mocking-policy: Use embedded fixtures, deterministic adapters, or fake clocks when network, time, or external state would otherwise make the task non-repeatable; do not mock away the behavior being taught or substitute a harness for final target-editor evidence.

Observability.evidence-format: module-id, verification-ref, artifact-path, mode, editor-profile, preservation-ledger, expected, actual, verdict, collection-sync
Observability.required-fields: moduleId, verificationRef, candidateId, artifactPath, validationDecision, mode, editorProfile, sourceLearningGoal, sourcePrerequisite, sourceRuntimeAssumption, destinationLocations, expected, actual, verdict, thematicCollection, interviewCollection, graphVerificationSync, beadsIssueId
Observability.stable-anchors: ← Все подборки; Условие; Код — вставьте его в редактор; Готово, когда; Подсказка 1 — куда смотреть; Подсказка 2 — с чего начать; Подсказка 3 — почти решение; Решение; Самопроверка; О задаче
Observability.redaction: Never place secrets, credentials, private student data, or proprietary source material in task cards or evidence.

AutonomyPolicy.replan-trigger: Ambiguous metadata, collection, editor, or task profile; duplicate learning goal; missing prerequisite or asset; unnecessary multi-file split; card/collection contradiction; unexpected GitHub rendering; unavailable mandatory evidence; or a solution requiring undeclared knowledge.
AutonomyPolicy.checkpoint-requirement: Every task change reports mode, editor profile, preservation ledger, artifacts changed, checks run, target-editor expected/actual/verdict, collection sync, remaining risk, and next action.

DeliveryShape.shape: GitHub repository whose root README is a short student hub, whose collections are the primary selection surface, and whose task directories render copy-ready self-contained Markdown cards.
DeliveryShape.implementation-state: Phase 8 implements the contract only; collections, card migrations, root cutover, and rendered audit remain pending in Phases 9 through 15.
